window_metrics.snr_note: median loud-half window frame RMS vs median sub--45dBFS window frame RMS; null when no quiet frames exist
window_metrics.scope_note: pitch, gaps, SNR, peak, RMS and clipping are all measured on the VR window, not the whole file

soulx_note: segment built from supplied annotation; per-note durations are uniform (trimmed/n) -- replace with measured per-note durations when available

upload.file: prompt_window.wav (the VR window slice; normalized.wav with --write-normalized)
upload.post_v1_voices: multipart: file=<audio>, prompt_meta=<file> when present; without prompt_meta the voice registers with soulx_ready=false
